Generated from [`fixtures/investigation/protocol.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/fixtures/investigation/protocol.yaml) by running Canon's own parser, validator and compiler over it. The protocol is deliberately not about software: Canon is meant to express any evidence-governed undertaking, and this is the fixture Canon's own tests use.

> Decide whether an explanation is supported by observation and survives an attempt to falsify it.

## The protocol

```yaml title="fixtures/investigation/protocol.yaml"
format: protocol/1

protocol:
  id: investigation
  revision: 1
  description: Decide whether an explanation is supported by observation and survives an attempt to falsify it.

artifacts:
  explanation:
    description: The explanation under investigation.

evidence_kinds:
  supporting_observation:
    description: An observation consistent with the explanation.
  falsification_attempt:
    description: An attempt to refute the explanation; its result is survived or refuted.

claims:
  explanation.supported:
    description: The explanation is supported by observation and has survived falsification.
    true_when:
      all:
        - evidence:
            kind: supporting_observation
        - evidence:
            kind: falsification_attempt
            result: survived

actions:
  inspect:
    description: Look for observations bearing on the explanation.
    may_produce:
      - evidence: supporting_observation

  attempt_falsification:
    description: Try to refute the explanation.
    may_produce:
      - evidence: falsification_attempt

outcomes:
  supported:
    description: The explanation is supported.
    requires:
      claim: explanation.supported
```

## What it declares

Protocol `investigation` at revision 1.

### Artifacts

| Artifact | Description |
|---|---|
| `explanation` | The explanation under investigation. |

### Evidence kinds

| Evidence kind | Description |
|---|---|
| `supporting_observation` | An observation consistent with the explanation. |
| `falsification_attempt` | An attempt to refute the explanation; its result is survived or refuted. |

### Claims

| Claim | True when | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `explanation.supported` | all of: evidence of kind `supporting_observation`; evidence of kind `falsification_attempt` with result `survived` | The explanation is supported by observation and has survived falsification. |

### Obligations

None declared.

### Actions

| Action | Precondition | Requires authority for | Effect | May produce | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inspect` | none: always applies | none | none | `supporting_observation` | Look for observations bearing on the explanation. |
| `attempt_falsification` | none: always applies | none | none | `falsification_attempt` | Try to refute the explanation. |

### Outcomes

| Outcome | Requires | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `supported` | claim `explanation.supported` is `true` | The explanation is supported. |

`canon validate --path fixtures/investigation/protocol.yaml` accepts it: the validator reports no problem. See [validation](./validation.md) for what it checks.

## Evaluating a case

`canon evaluate` reads the compiled protocol, a [`canon-case/1`](./documents.md) snapshot and a directory of [`canon-evidence/1`](./documents.md) records, and prints a `canon-decision/1` document. These values are computed by Canon's evaluator for the case below; see [evaluation](./evaluation.md) for the rules.

```yaml title="case.yaml"
format: canon-case/1
id: INV-18
protocol: investigation
artifacts:
  explanation:
    revision: r1
```

| Evidence on record | Value |
|---|---|
| Nothing yet | `explanation.supported` is `unknown` |
| A supporting observation only | `explanation.supported` is `unknown` |
| A supporting observation, and a falsification attempt the explanation survived | `explanation.supported` is `true` |
| A supporting observation, and a falsification attempt that refuted it | `explanation.supported` is `false` |
| A supporting observation, and two falsification attempts that disagree | `explanation.supported` is `unknown` |

With a supporting observation and a falsification attempt the explanation survived, the evidence directory holds these two records:

```yaml
format: canon-evidence/1
id: obs-1
kind: supporting_observation
subject: explanation
subject_revision: r1
```

```yaml
format: canon-evidence/1
id: fal-1
kind: falsification_attempt
result: survived
subject: explanation
subject_revision: r1
```

and `canon evaluate --ir investigation.ir.json --case case.yaml --evidence evidence/` prints:

```json
{
  "case": "INV-18",
  "claims": {
    "explanation.supported": {
      "value": "true"
    }
  },
  "format": "canon-decision/1",
  "protocol": "investigation",
  "protocol_revision": 1
}
```

Only claims are evaluated today: obligations, actions and outcomes are not, and a record's subject and subject revision are read but do not yet affect the result.

## Broken variants

The repository keeps broken copies of this protocol in [`fixtures/investigation/invalid`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/fixtures/investigation/invalid). Each is rejected; these are the problems the validator reports for them.

| Variant | Code | Problem |
|---|---|---|
| [`duplicate-identifier.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/fixtures/investigation/invalid/duplicate-identifier.yaml) | `duplicate-identifier` | action `inspect` is declared more than once |
| [`undeclared-claim.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/fixtures/investigation/invalid/undeclared-claim.yaml) | `undeclared-claim` | outcome `supported` references claim `explanation.refuted`, which is not declared |
| [`undeclared-discharge-claim.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/fixtures/investigation/invalid/undeclared-discharge-claim.yaml) | `undeclared-claim` | obligation `establish.explanation` references claim `explanation.refuted`, which is not declared |
| [`undeclared-evidence-kind.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/fixtures/investigation/invalid/undeclared-evidence-kind.yaml) | `undeclared-evidence-kind` | action `attempt_falsification` references evidence kind `expert_opinion`, which is not declared |
